samples.summary: New cell-aware copy branch resolves parentage through the body-only `layout.blockParentMap`, so a copy from a header/footer table cell still produces an empty rich payload
samples.evidence: `getSelectedBlocks()` now does `const cellInfo = layout.blockParentMap.get(start.blockId)` with `layout = this.getLayout()` (text-editor.ts:3734/3747). Every sibling cell-resolution path in the same class uses the region-aware map instead: `isInTable()`/`getCellInfo()` at text-editor.ts:3356 and 3363 use `this.getActiveLayout().blockParentMap`, and `Doc.blockParentMap` is the merged body+header+footer map used by `range-slices.ts:160-163`. The design doc records exactly this trap: docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:513-516 — "Parentage comes from `doc.blockParentMap` (the merged body + header + footer map), not the body-only `layout.blockParentMap` ... which returned an empty summary for a header-cell selection." So the #872 class of bug (empty WAFFLEDOCS_MIME, styles/images lost) remains for header/footer table cells, and the in-diff comment claiming this is "the same path `isInTable()` / `getSelectedText()` already walk" is inaccurate about `isInTable()`.

samples.summary: The table-cell copy fix (#872) has no context-menu affordance: in-table right-clicks bypass DocsContextMenu entirely, and the table menu has no Copy item and bails in read-only
samples.evidence: `docs-context-menu.tsx:68` — `if (editor.isInTable()) return;` hands every in-table right-click to `DocsTableContextMenu`, which contains no Copy/Cut/Paste item at all and early-returns in read-only (`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-table-context-menu.tsx:70` `if (readOnly) return;`). So the newly-relaxed `showCopy = hasSelection` never applies where the sibling fix in this PR matters most (a selection inside a table cell), and a read-only viewer right-clicking inside a table still gets no menu.

samples.summary: Menu consumer of the new image copy/cut support was not updated: an image selection makes `getActiveSelection()` null, so right-clicking a selected image offers neither Copy nor Cut
samples.evidence: `selectImageAt` calls `selection.setRange(null)` before setting `selectedImage` (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3643), so `hasSelection = !!editor.getActiveSelection()` (docs-context-menu.tsx:74) is false whenever an image is selected. `handleCopy`/`handleCut` now support that case (text-editor.ts:1190-1197, 1224-1231) but `showCopy = hasSelection` (line 181) and `showCut = hasSelection && !readOnly` (line 176) both hide the items, leaving keyboard ⌘C/⌘X and the context menu inconsistent for the very case this PR adds.

samples.summary: Platform/mod-key detection duplicated into editor.ts instead of reusing the single existing site in TextEditor
samples.evidence: `const mod = /Mac|iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(navigator.platform) ? e.metaKey : e.ctrlKey` (editor.ts:2295-2297) is a verbatim copy of `packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:874-875`, which was the only occurrence in packages/docs/src. The two must stay in lockstep — the new `imageKeyHandler` branch is deliberately mirroring `handleKeyDown`'s normalization — so any future change to platform detection (e.g. moving off deprecated `navigator.platform` to `userAgentData`) now has to be applied in two files or the image path silently diverges from the text path.
